contract.title: Incident Response Dashboard Visual Unification
acceptance_criteria: Only the three explicit IncidentResponseOverviewPage TSX CSS and test paths may change; no Queue, Command Center, route, shell, other workspace, backend, provider, runtime, environment or reference path may change.

The immutable visual authority is .ai/references/TASK-0125-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 13b0739e46aecebef1b4013ac86f8ae11a86b1d214be2a67f2946fdd08177435, dimensions 1402 x 1122 and size 1302937 bytes.

The overview contains only the compact Incident Response header, Incident Response Snapshot, Active Incidents, Response Status, Response Playbooks and Recent Activity regions in the measured task geometry.
Exactly five snapshot instruments appear in reference order with approximately 231 234 225 228 223 pixel widths, approximately 131px height and 13 to 14px gaps within task tolerances.

The Active Incidents and Response Status middle panels follow the measured approximately 613 to 596 split and the Response Playbooks and Recent Activity lower panels preserve the same composition without overlap, clipping or document overflow.
The overview calls only the existing getIncidents boundary once and distinguishes loading, request error, successfully loaded empty queue, no active incidents and real active incidents.
Only canonical incidents whose exact lifecycle_status is open or investigating are counted and displayed as active; resolved, closed and unknown values are not treated as active.
Real active rows display only canonical queue values and link the exact encoded incident ID to /incident-response/incidents/<incidentId>/command-center.
Critical Incidents and MTTR remain Unavailable, Contained Incidents remains Unavailable and Open Tasks remains Not connected without numbers, trends or inferred values.
Response Status retains a neutral recognizable visualization with an explicit Unavailable state and no percentage, status distribution or data series.
Response Playbooks remains Not connected and Recent Activity remains Unavailable without illustrative rows, playbooks, activity entries, relative times or synthetic timelines.
The overview does not call the incident-scoped Command Center client, execute providers or aggregate notes and activities across incidents.
No mockup number, incident, severity, status value, task, playbook, trend, timestamp or other illustrative security data is copied into product code or asserted as productive data.
Existing Incident Queue loading, error, empty, search and exact Command Center navigation behavior remains byte-identical and passing.
Existing Incident Command Center request, loading, error, references, notes, activities and incident identity behavior remains byte-identical and passing.
All canonical Incident Response routes, deep links, Back and Forward behavior, URL authority and Sidebar selection remain passing.
Page-local CSS implements measured insets, grid ratios, panel heights, gaps, borders, radii, typography and navy status surfaces without changing global CSS or the Platform shell.
Focused tests prove the geometry contract, truthful snapshot states, exact active subset, all loader states, exact deep links, absent fake data and absent automatic detail or provider calls.
Existing Sidebar, Topbar, WorkspaceSwitcher, cross-workspace, TASK-0122, TASK-0123 and TASK-0124 regressions remain passing.
Full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass; Scope Guard reports exactly the three authorized files and all protected reference hashes remain unchanged.
Architect Implementation Review and Product Owner browser acceptance at 1402 x 1122 and 100 percent zoom remain mandatory before DONE.
Do not transition TASK-0125 to DONE or create TASK-0126.
